 Learn more Siebert Financial chief investment officer Mark Malek and his panel of experts weigh in on why exchange-traded funds (ETFs) deserve a closer look. The panel explores the benefits of ETF investing, the value professional fund managers can bring and tax benefits of they offer 
 Today's panel includes TMX Wall Street Horizon Head of Corporate Event Research Christine Short, Howard Capital Management CEO and Portfolio Manager Vance Howard, Wellington-Altus Chief Market Strategist Jim Thorne, and Amplify ETFs CEO Christian Magoon,
